items.item: Each row shows the user's name and email, role, status in words (such as Active, Invited, Deactivated, Locked) and whether two-factor sign-in is enabled
items.evidence: renderRow() (page.html:586-615) outputs name, email, role, and statusBadge() text labels ('Đang hoạt động'/'Chờ xác nhận'/'Đã vô hiệu hóa'), but there is no two-factor/2FA/MFA column or indicator anywhere in the row markup or STATUS_META.

items.item: Last sign-in uses one date-time format with the timezone stated, relative times also expose the exact time, and an account that has never signed in shows "Never" rather than a blank or a 1970 date
items.evidence: formatDateTime() uses TIME_ZONE='Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' internally for Intl formatting but never renders a timezone label/abbreviation in the UI (e.g. row shows '07/11/2026 09:12' with no 'GMT+7' or zone text). Relative time does appear alongside the exact timestamp ('· 15 phút trước'), and never-logged-in rows correctly show 'Chưa đăng nhập' (='Never signed in') instead of blank/1970, but the missing timezone disclosure fails the item overall.

items.item: Users can be found by searching name or email and filtered by role, status and inactivity (such as no sign-in for 90+ days), with the number of matching users shown
items.evidence: searchInput filters foldVi(name)/foldVi(email) (matchesBaseFilters, page.html:448-461); roleSelect filters by role; statusTabs (#statusTabs) filter by status; 'Đăng nhập gần nhất' from/to date range (loginFrom/loginTo) lets admins filter by last sign-in window, covering inactivity use case; resultSummary shows '28 người dùng phù hợp' count.

items.item: The invite form requires an email and a role, labels both fields, and shows an inline error for a malformed address or one that already has an account
items.evidence: inviteEmail and inviteRole are both required with labels and inline error elements (#inviteEmail-error, #inviteRole-error); malformed email is caught by regex /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ producing 'Nhập một email hợp lệ...'. However INVITE_FIELDS has no check against existing users/emails — submit handler (page.html:979-996) only validates presence/format, never compares against USERS, so a duplicate email shows no inline error.

items.item: Deactivation asks for confirmation that names the user and states the effect (active sessions ended, sign-in blocked, data kept), and a deactivated user is offered Reactivate instead
items.evidence: handleRowAction('disable') (page.html:883-895) opens a confirm naming the user ('Vô hiệu hóa tài khoản {row.name}?') and states sessions end + sign-in blocked ('Họ sẽ bị đăng xuất ngay lập tức và không thể đăng nhập lại...'), but never mentions data being kept/retained. rowActionsForStatus() does offer 'Kích hoạt lại tài khoản' (Reactivate) for disabled users, which passes, but the missing data-retention statement fails the item as a whole.

items.item: The signed-in administrator's own row is marked (such as "You") and cannot be deactivated or lose the admin role, and the last remaining administrator cannot be deactivated, with the disabled action explaining why
items.evidence: No 'You' marker exists anywhere in renderRow() or the mock USERS data, and there is no logic in handleRowAction/bulkDeactivateBtn that checks for self-row, admin role protection, or last-remaining-admin — row-menu actions (page.html:570-584) are identical for every active row regardless of role or identity.

items.item: Password reset sends a reset link to the user's email address, which the confirmation names, and the administrator never sees, sets or types the new password
items.evidence: handleRowAction('reset') (page.html:874-882) confirm dialog states 'Một email đặt lại mật khẩu sẽ được gửi tới {row.email}' and on confirm shows toast 'Đã gửi email đặt lại mật khẩu tới {row.email}'; no password input field exists anywhere in the admin UI.

items.item: Row actions are buttons or a keyboard-operable menu whose accessible names include the user (such as "Actions for Mai Nguyen"), and the outcome of an action is announced in an aria-live or role="status" region
items.evidence: row-menu-btn has aria-label="Hành động cho {name}" (='Actions for {name}', page.html:610); rowMenu supports ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Escape keyboard navigation (page.html:1151-1157); showToast() creates elements with role="status" (page.html:775) to announce outcomes like 'Đã vô hiệu hóa tài khoản {name}'.

items.item: A search with no matching users shows a message with a way to clear it, and loading and failed-load states with a retry exist
items.evidence: emptyStateRow('no-results') (page.html:561-568) shows 'Không có người dùng khớp...' with a '#clearFiltersBtn' ('Xóa bộ lọc'); skeletonRows() plus aria-busy='true' implements the loading state; emptyStateRow('error') (page.html:547-552) shows 'Không thể tải danh sách người dùng' with '#retryLoadBtn' ('Thử lại').

notes: No listed template tells (greeting-header, kpi-icon-tiles, delta-pill-without-period, gradient, glass, tracked-uppercase-labels, emoji-icon, rainbow-status, sidebar-promo-card, decorative-chart, card-in-card, hover-lift, oversized-radius, navy-sidebar-indigo-accent) were found; grep for gradient/uppercase/backdrop-blur/scale/indigo/navy/oversized-radius classes returned no matches, icons are plain SVG not emoji, and status badges use only 3 semantic colors. initials-avatar is used but correctly represents real people (not a non-person entity), so it does not qualify as the initials-avatar-non-person tell. Automated audit (audit.json) separately flags text-contrast failures on the inactive status-tab counts (2.45:1, needs 4.5:1) and flags plain-text emails lacking mailto: links — both outside this checklist's scope but worth noting.
